$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F06 three-quarter (A2) from the wearer's right. The engraved wordmark and the old emblem after it come off the near temple. The GCD is placed with the old print as a ruler (tools/photo/temple_gcd.py): its ends lie 26.3 and 41.4 mm from the hinge, measured in the 3D model on the hero (IMG_3483), where the whole temple height shows and nothing depends on where its lit top face ends. The 3D model here agrees within 2 to 7%, depending on that top face. The near half of the shield is seen at a steep angle and kept as photographed (lens_cleanup.as_shot): measured against the tent it came out lighter than the frame round it, with a ragged step along the bottom of SAM's mask. The old print on the far temple's inner face shows faintly through the far half of the shield; it takes the smoothest surface through its border (fill smooth).

lenses.name: shield lens, far half, past the nose arch

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges)
old print on the far temple's inner face, seen faintly through the far half of the shield
